name: Harness Boot
description: Multi-agent development harness for Claude Code. Your AI has speed; we give it direction — through living specs and focused specialist agents.
longDescription:
Ships **2 skills**, **17 agents**, **5 commands** and **3 hooks**.

- **Skills** (2): `feature-author` (Convert a feature idea into a complete `features[]` entry for `.harness/spec.yaml` — auto-detects shape (UI / sensitive /…), `spec-conversion` (기획 문서(plan.md 등) 또는 아키텍처 문서(architecture.md 등)를 harness-boot 의 `.harness/spec.yaml` (v2.3.8 스키마)로 변환할 때 사용)
- **Agents** (17): `a11y-auditor` (Accessibility auditor — cross-checks ux-architect, visual-designer, audio-designer, and frontend-engineer outputs against WCAG 2.2 and writes `.harness/_workspace/a11y/report.md`), `audio-designer` (Auditory experience designer — produces a sound-cue catalog · volume/mix · silence policy · audio branding to `.harness/_workspace/design/audio.yaml`), `backend-engineer` (Server / service / DB specialist — owns APIs, persistence, domain logic, and event pipelines), `frontend-engineer` (UI implementation specialist — reads visual-designer's tokens.yaml + components.yaml and ux-architect's flows.md, then builds framework-neutral web/mobile/desktop components), `integrator` (System assembler — wires together the pieces individual engineers built so the system runs end-to-end), `orchestrator` (Coordinates multi-step harness work and delegates to specialist sub-agents), `performance-engineer` (Performance specialist — profiling, bottleneck analysis, performance-budget management, latency/throughput/resource budgets), `product-planner` (Product planner — takes researcher's brief.md and **decides** the feature set, roadmap, acceptance criteria, and trade-offs, writing the…), and 9 more
- **Commands** (5): `_work-ceremonies`, `_work-orchestration`, `drive` (Bounded autonomous loop driver — natural-language goal → researcher → planner → feature-author → execute loop, with explicit…), `init` (Install the harness-boot plugin into the current project — scaffold .harness/ + wire CLAUDE.md), `work` (Per-feature TDD lifecycle manager — activate · record gate result · gather evidence · transition to done (F-004))
- **Hooks** (3): `SessionStart`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `Stop`

Installs with `claude plugin install harness-boot@claude-community` from `qwerfunch/harness-boot`.
